basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, is filling one Senior Project Associate - Research post in the DBT-funded project IndiaCAN-Twin. The consolidated pay is up to Rs. 42,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The tenure is 24 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. Applications are invited online under advertisement no. IIT/SRIC/R/IND/2026/102, and the last date is 20 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

how_to_apply: The notice invites applications online and fixes 20 November 2026 as the last date of application. It does not print a website address or application link. The notice also lists these bank details for fee deposit (RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking):
Bank name: State Bank of India (00202)
Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302
Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account
The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Senior Project Associate - Research at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the selection process or an interview date.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy)
IndiaCAN-Twin: Towards AI-Powered Digital Twin Platform for Early Detection and Personalized Care in Indian Oral Cancer (Project Code – R/IND)
DBT, New Delhi (Government of India, Ministry of Science and Technology, Department of Biotechnology)
24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation up to Rs. 42,000 per month (depending on qualification and experience)
Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for the post, as printed in the notice, has two routes. The candidate should be excellent in Programming and Data Structures, Probability and Statistics, and Discrete Maths. The candidate should preferably have a GATE score and a CGPA > 8.0. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

rows.essential_qualification: Masters degree Physics or Engineering or Technology or natural sciences, or bachelors degree in Engineering or Technology, from a recognized university or equivalent, and four years experience in Research and Development in Industrial and academic institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services
Doctoral degree in Science/Engineering/Technology from a recognized university or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 42,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The assignment is temporary and lasts 24 months or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Senior Project Associate - Research
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications online and fixes 20 November 2026 as the last date of application. It does not print a website address or application link. The notice also lists these bank details for fee deposit (RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking): Bank name: State Bank of India (00202) Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302 Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account Account no.: 39502115210 IFSC code: SBIN0000202 SWIFT code: SBININBB339 The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the IIT Kharagpur Senior Project Associate - Research recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Senior Project Associate - Research in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A masters degree in Physics or Engineering or Technology or natural sciences, or a bachelors degree in Engineering or Technology, plus four years of Research and Development experience; or a doctoral degree in Science/Engineering/Technology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years, as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 42,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project, for 24 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q9. Does meeting the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
